'''Enhanced Premiere''' is the 19th expansion of Star Wars CCG.
It is published by Decipher in November 1998 and consists of 6 premium cards. Versions of Luke, Han, Leia, Obi-Wan, Vader, and Boba Fett with their personal weapons built in.

There are '''six''' die-cut packs, not one undifferentiated product. Each pack shows one premium character through the window and also contains four [[Premiere Unlimited]] boosters.

* [[Luke With Lightsaber]] pack
* [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]] pack
* [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]] pack
* [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]] pack
* [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] pack
* [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]] pack

Early display boxes had 3 Luke / 3 Vader / 2 Boba Fett / 2 Obi-Wan / 1 Han / 1 Leia; later boxes had 2 of each.<ref name="encyclopedia">https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf</ref>
